command:
set -euo pipefail; TS=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S); B=backups/crush-reentry-pre-$TS; mkdir -p "$B"; cp -a harness_crush_knopf.sh harness_crush_knopf.py "$B/"; cat > harness_crush_knopf.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# FranKenstein Free Frank — canonical GRID10/UnifiedDB reentry harness on Andreas-MACO.
# API keys are loaded internally by harness_aider.py from Andreas' own ~/.last-resort/keys.env;
# no key material is echoed or copied here.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/npm-global/bin:$PATH"
cd "$HOME/.claude/star" || exit 1
python3 harness_crush_knopf.py
exec bash
EOF
chmod +x harness_crush_knopf.sh; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('harness_crush_knopf.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
start=s.index('def _chatgpt_bridge_status() -> str:')
end=s.index('\n\ndef _banner_drucken()', start)
new='''def _chatgpt_bridge_status() -> str:
    """Honest readiness status for the two independent bridge layers.

    Local command bridge must be active, and the ChatGPT browser transport must
    have a usable authenticated session. Never report merely AN because systemd
    happens to be green. This fixes the false-green status seen on ai-core-node.
    """
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["systemctl", "--user", "is-active", "frankenstein-local-bridge.service"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
        )
        local_ok = out.stdout.strip() == "active"
    except Exception:
        local_ok = False
    if not local_ok:
        return "ChatGPT-Bridge: AUS (Local-Bridge nicht aktiv)"
    try:
        import stern as _stern
        lage = _stern._chatgpt_login_sicherstellen()
        if lage.get("eingeloggt"):
            return "ChatGPT-Bridge: AN (Local + ChatGPT-Transport bereit)"
        return "ChatGPT-Bridge: TEILBEREIT (Local AN, ChatGPT-Login fehlt)"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"ChatGPT-Bridge: TEILBEREIT (Local AN, Transportfehler: {type(e).__name__})"
'''
p.write_text(s[:start]+new+s[end:], encoding='utf-8')
PY
python3 -m py_compile harness_crush_knopf.py harness_crush.py harness_aider.py frank_chatgpt_terminal.py; echo '=== launcher ==='; cat harness_crush_knopf.sh; echo '=== status function smoke ==='; python3 - <<'PY'
import harness_crush_knopf as h
print(h._chatgpt_bridge_status())
PY
echo ENABLED_REENTRY_LAUNCHER
